title: VibeVoice, 0.5B

tricks: Sampling is turned on and the denoising steps are doubled to 10, away from the flat default
Emma is one of two female voices; Grace is the other and was not picked by ear yet
No tags exist, so every sound is dropped
Very short lines of three words or fewer can be unstable

why: VibeVoice's small checkpoint with sampling on and more denoising steps, because its stock setting is the flattest it can run.
